review_candidates.description: You have spent years working with command-and-control systems in the field — and you know exactly what they can do, and where they fall short. Now imagine applying that expertise to help define how battle-proven C2 technology protects power grids, police forces, national crisis authorities and critical infrastructure. This is a rare opportunity to move at the frontier of a genuinely new domain, with the market-leading platform and the mandate to shape it. The job As Senior Domain Advisor, you'll be the go-to SitaWare expert across Systematic's National Security & Infrastructure (NSI) unit — the person colleagues, customers, and partners turn to when deep functional knowledge and operational credibility matter most. You'll configure and demonstrate SitaWare solutions in presales processes and customer engagements, and feed real-world operational insight directly into product development and roadmap discussions. Equally important is your outward-facing role. Systematic is actively building its position as a thought leader at the intersection of defence-grade C2 technology and civil security — and you'll be central to that effort. Working across Crisis Management, Asset Protection, and Marine Coordination, you'll help customers in emergency services, critical infrastructure, police, and national crisis authorities understand what SitaWare can do for them, and you'll identify the new workflows and use cases that will take it further. In short, you can look forward to: Acting as SitaWare superuser: configuring and demonstrating solutions across presales, bids, and senior customer engagements Translating military operational experience into concrete product and solution opportunities for the NSI domain Advising product management and development teams — connecting real-world needs with SitaWare's evolving capabilities Engaging senior stakeholders in emergency services, police, and critical infrastructure, building credibility through hands-on expertise Contributing to thought leadership, use case development, and domain knowledge sharing across the unit. Joining the team Systematic's NSI unit is one of the company's most significant growth areas, and one of its most strategically important. Built on the same SitaWare platform trusted by NATO and allied forces in more than 50 countries, NSI is translating four decades of defence-grade technology into solutions that protect the systems society depends on — from offshore energy infrastructure to national emergency coordination. The team works across Crisis Management, Asset Protection, and Marine Coordination, and the connections between those domains are exactly where the most interesting challenges live. This is a new role, and deliberately so. You'll work closely with product managers, architects, developers, and business development managers — with real influence on where the unit goes next. The team is tight knit, highly capable, and genuinely values operational domain knowledge. Your experience won't sit in a drawer here; it will drive decisions. Join us at the start of this exciting journey – we need your expertise and positive energy to help shape the future! You can read more about our business unit National Security here and Critical Infrastructure here. Your Qualifications Military education at Captain or Major level, or equivalent Solid operational experience from the Danish Army or equivalent force, with hands-on use of command-and-control systems in real or exercise environments Direct experience with SitaWare — as an operational user, superuser, or in a configuration or advisory capacity Strong IT proficiency at superuser level Fluency in Danish and English, written and spoken Experience supporting demonstrations, presentations or advisory work Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites and Systematic offices, nationally and internationally. Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or EU country for the past seven years, as we work with security-classified projects. Read more: https: //systematic.com/int/careers/security-clearance/ Welcome to Systematic Aarhus At our Aarhus office, you can look forward to joining our Employees Club, which offers nearly 100 events a year of both social and professional character. Here, you can take advantage of a range of on-site perks from physiotherapist-led massages and an in-house hairdresser to sports clubs, game tables and even our own padel court. Our canteen is a standout feature, serving a daily selection of delicious and healthy dishes. Beyond the office, you will also enjoy benefits like free ARoS +1 access and various shopping discounts. Never stop developing Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international, and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1,100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong. Start your development here We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Ole Spielberg. Connect with us!

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team! Job Description After an initial training period, you will be responsible for the installation, start-up, troubleshooting and preventive maintenance of our injection molding systems at our customers' facilities. You will operate from your home office ideally located in Warsaw, Katowice or Krakow area with general administrative support from our European headquarters in Luxembourg. This position offers great challenges and has a direct impact on the final business result and growth opportunities. It is a unique opportunity to join a very dynamic organization, combining your technology focus and inter-human skills to support our global customer base.
